audit: Frontier Lab plain-language source safety review
sourceSetHashMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of the ordered {path,sha256} entries, using UTF-8 working-tree file bytes for each file hash.

nonTextSyntaxAndOperators.method: Compare TypeScript AST structure and operators after removing JSX text and replacing literal/template text with placeholders. Normalize only the four reviewed presentation changes listed below.

gameplayIdentifiersAndExpressions.exceptions: Only the declared display-label expressions below were simplified.

eventHandlerLogic.detail: Callback bodies, conditions, handlers and non-display arguments match; status-message wording may differ.

protectedStrings.detail: Checked changed strings for imports, types, switch and comparison values, object keys, element indexes, structural DOM attributes, command/navigation IDs and machine properties/calls. Reviewed table labels, callback messages and rendered props as display copy.

knownExceptions.change: Generic return label replaces a concatenated task title with “Back to your choices”.
knownExceptions.scope: Conditional branches and navigation remain unchanged.

knownExceptions.change: Detour reminder removes the interpolated lowercased task name.
knownExceptions.scope: Display sentence only; return handler and disabled conditions match.

knownExceptions.change: Draft button keeps the task title capitalization after “Continue:”.
knownExceptions.scope: Removes display-only toLowerCase(); task identity and click handler match.

knownExceptions.change: About-this-version overview changes from two static paragraphs to three.
knownExceptions.scope: Static prose only; diagnostics, version values, fingerprint and controls match.

additionalCopyObservation: The chip progress summary removes a standalone JSX text node (“grants”); both dynamic expressions are unchanged. This is covered by the JSX-text comparison, not a gameplay exception.
limits: Source-diff review only. Rendered layout, type checking, production build and gameplay tests are recorded separately. Reworded messages can change text in newly produced records; this audit does not claim serialized-save byte equality.
